# FitnessGym

> FitnessGym is a demonstration gym website built with React by Dawid Olko. It presents training classes, trainers, membership plans, a supplement shop with a cart, a blog and a contact page.

## Pages

- [Home](https://fitnessgym.dawidolko.pl/): overview of the gym, classes, plans and trainers
- [About](https://fitnessgym.dawidolko.pl/about/): the story of the gym and the people who run it
- [Shop](https://fitnessgym.dawidolko.pl/shop/): protein, creatine, pre-workout and other products
- [FAQ](https://fitnessgym.dawidolko.pl/faq/): answers about memberships, classes and payments
- [Blog](https://fitnessgym.dawidolko.pl/blog/): articles on training, nutrition and motivation
- [Contact](https://fitnessgym.dawidolko.pl/contact/): location, phone, email and contact form

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer, author of this project
